acceptance: Schemas are closed, bounded, deterministic, and fail closed on malformed/unknown input or an invalid lifecycle transition.

Confirm/correct/supersede replay produces stable ledger state while preserving the immutable origin AssumptionRecordV1; the same canonical input/event sequence produces byte-equivalent semantic output identities.
Correction and supersession emit deterministic invalidation manifests whose dependent-work/evidence references are sorted, deduplicated, bounded, and carry no execution authority.
Focused tests cover every valid action, invalid transitions, field constraints, identity/order, empty/non-empty invalidation sets, malformed input, replay determinism, and caller-input immutability.

The exact implementation candidate later passes full repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline R2, Alibaba OCR review/accounting where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused lifecycle/replay/invalidation tests plus full repository gates.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR accounting/delegated review where applicable, Jev where available, exact-head CI, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: SG-000031 intentionally excludes lifecycle/invalidation behavior. A small dedicated event/reducer module composes with the existing immutable AssumptionRecordV1 without widening Question Gate policy or introducing persistence.

requirements: Ledger confirmation/correction/supersession is product-planning evidence and cannot become capability, security, billing, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority.
Invalidation manifests identify stale dependent work/evidence but do not delete, mutate, cancel, or rerun anything automatically.
Malformed inputs, contradictory transitions, stale assumption identities, and action-field mismatches fail closed.

outcome: An inferred assumption can be deterministically confirmed, corrected, or superseded while the ledger emits stable invalidation references for dependent work/evidence and never grants runtime authority or performs the invalidation side effect itself.
rationale: SG-000031 delivers the deterministic Question Gate and immutable inferred AssumptionRecordV1. The remaining canonical P02-S04 outcome requires assumption correction/invalidation. The smallest dependent slice is an event-sourced lifecycle/reducer plus an inspectable invalidation manifest; persistence/UI/execution stay downstream.

risk.recovery: Revert the assumption-ledger module, exports, tests, and evidence. SG-000031 Question Gate core remains closed and IN-P02-S04-T01 remains partially complete.

scope_in: Define a closed AssumptionLedgerEventInputV1 contract bound to an existing AssumptionRecordV1, with confirm/correct/supersede actions, bounded source text, action-specific replacement data, and bounded dependent-work/evidence reference lists.

Implement a deterministic event/reducer state machine that preserves the original AssumptionRecordV1, rejects invalid or contradictory transitions, and produces inspectable inferred/confirmed/corrected/superseded ledger state without mutation of caller input.

For correction or supersession, emit a stable AssumptionInvalidationManifestV1 containing canonical sorted/deduplicated dependent-work and evidence references; empty invalidation sets remain explicit and deterministic.

Keep confirmation/correction/supersession as product-planning evidence only: confirmation may update ledger state but cannot grant capabilities, authorize privileged/external effects, or bypass later security/publish gates.

Add focused tests for valid transitions, invalid transition order, action-specific required/forbidden fields, deterministic event/invalidation identities, canonical ordering, bounds, malformed/unknown inputs, immutability, and replay determinism.
scope_out: No UI/question batching, persistence/database writes, source/Git mutation, task cancellation, evidence deletion, cache eviction, or automatic downstream re-execution; this Grain emits invalidation data only.
No model/provider/CLM/Jev invocation or learned routing; no natural-language assumption generation.
No Product Graph user views, P03 run lifecycle, capability grants, credentials, billing, deployment, publication, or external effects.
No change to SG-000031 Question Gate policy thresholds or derive/assume/ask/defer decision semantics.
